The Foundation

Infrastructure Done Once, Done Right

Most security problems we are called about start in the cabling: unlabeled runs, overloaded PoE switches, cable laid on ceiling tiles. We install the physical layer the way we install life-safety systems, to published standards, and hand you test results and drawings at the end.

For general contractors, that means one low-voltage partner for data, security and fire alarm on the same schedule.

What We Install

Copper, Fiber and Everything in Between

Category 6 & 6A Copper

Horizontal cabling for workstations, phones, access points, cameras and readers, rated for today's PoE loads.

Fiber Optic Backbone

Single-mode and multimode fiber between floors and buildings, terminated and tested.

Telecom Rooms & Racks

Racks, cable management, patch panels, ladder rack and grounding, built to be serviced.

Testing & Certification

Every link tested with a certification tester, with results delivered at closeout.

Labeling & As-Builts

Both ends labeled to a consistent scheme and matched to drawings you can hand to IT.

Pathways & Firestopping

J-hooks, sleeves and firestopped penetrations that pass inspection the first time.
